evidence.reason: qemu_command joins the run directory into QEMU -drive option strings without escaping or rejecting commas (line 216 only resolves the path; no validation exists). QEMU parses -drive values by splitting on commas, so a state directory such as `probe,local` yields `file=/.../probe,local/overlay.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2`, where `local/overlay.qcow2` is misread as an option name and QEMU rejects the argument or starts with the wrong device. This is an ordinary correctness defect in existing intended behavior (preparation creates the files, then launch fails), not a new requirement or hardening proposal; the smallest fix is to double embedded commas in the path values used in QEMU options (or reject such paths).
